# Kunemi UI — Complete Technical Reference

> Accessible, extensible, and AI-native React design system built on Base UI primitives, styled with Tailwind CSS v4 and semantic CSS variables, and distributed via a shadcn-compatible registry.

---

## 1. Design Tokens & Theme Foundation

Kunemi UI uses certified WCAG 2.2 AA contrast pairings mapped to CSS variables. All colors adapt seamlessly across `light` and `dark` themes.

### Semantic CSS Variables
```css
:root {
  --background: #ffffff;
  --foreground: #09090b;
  --card: #ffffff;
  --card-foreground: #09090b;
  --popover: #ffffff;
  --popover-foreground: #09090b;
  --primary: #18181b;
  --primary-foreground: #fafafa;
  --secondary: #f4f4f5;
  --secondary-foreground: #18181b;
  --muted: #f4f4f5;
  --muted-foreground: #71717a;
  --accent: #f4f4f5;
  --accent-foreground: #18181b;
  --destructive: #ef4444;
  --destructive-foreground: #fafafa;
  --border: #e4e4e7;
  --input: #e4e4e7;
  --ring: #18181b;
  --radius: 0.5rem;
}

.dark {
  --background: #09090b;
  --foreground: #fafafa;
  --card: #09090b;
  --card-foreground: #fafafa;
  --popover: #09090b;
  --popover-foreground: #fafafa;
  --primary: #fafafa;
  --primary-foreground: #18181b;
  --secondary: #27272a;
  --secondary-foreground: #fafafa;
  --muted: #27272a;
  --muted-foreground: #a1a1aa;
  --accent: #27272a;
  --accent-foreground: #fafafa;
  --destructive: #7f1d1d;
  --destructive-foreground: #fafafa;
  --border: #27272a;
  --input: #27272a;
  --ring: #d4d4d8;
}
```

### Theme Provider Usage
```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

export function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <body>
        <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="system" storageKey="kunemi-theme">
          {children}
        </ThemeProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

---

## 2. Component API Reference

### Button
```tsx
import { Button } from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<Button variant="default">Save</Button>
<Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="outline">Preview</Button>
<Button variant="ghost">Clear</Button>
<Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
<Button size="sm">Small</Button>
<Button size="lg">Large</Button>
<Button size="icon" aria-label="Settings"><SettingsIcon /></Button>
```

### Input & Label
```tsx
import { Input, Label } from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<div>
  <Label htmlFor="email" requiredIndicator>Email Address</Label>
  <Input id="email" type="email" placeholder="you@domain.com" />
</div>
```

### Checkbox & Switch
```tsx
import { Checkbox, Switch, Label } from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  <Checkbox id="terms" />
  <Label htmlFor="terms">Accept conditions</Label>
</div>

<div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  <Switch id="stream-mode" />
  <Label htmlFor="stream-mode">Enable live streaming</Label>
</div>
```

### Dialog
```tsx
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogTrigger,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogBackdrop,
  DialogPopup,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogClose,
  Button,
} from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger render={<Button>Open Dialog</Button>} />
  <DialogPortal>
    <DialogBackdrop />
    <DialogPopup>
      <DialogTitle>Confirm Action</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>
        This action cannot be undone. Are you sure you wish to proceed?
      </DialogDescription>
      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-4">
        <DialogClose render={<Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>} />
        <Button variant="destructive">Confirm</Button>
      </div>
    </DialogPopup>
  </DialogPortal>
</Dialog>
```

### Select
```tsx
import {
  Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
} from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<Select defaultValue="gpt4">
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select model" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="gpt4">GPT-4o</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="claude">Claude 3.5 Sonnet</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="gemini">Gemini 2.0 Flash</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

### PromptInput (AI-Native)
```tsx
import { PromptInput } from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<PromptInput
  placeholder="Ask anything (Enter to submit, Shift+Enter for newline)..."
  onSubmit={(val) => console.log("Submitted:", val)}
  onCancel={() => console.log("Cancelled")}
  isLoading={false}
/>
```

### ToolStatus (AI-Native)
```tsx
import { ToolStatus } from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<ToolStatus
  toolName="Database Query"
  status="running"
  args={{ sql: "SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10" }}
/>
<ToolStatus
  toolName="File Search"
  status="succeeded"
  result={{ matchCount: 42 }}
/>
```

### ApprovalDialog (AI-Native)
```tsx
import { ApprovalDialog } from "@kunemi-ui/ui";

<ApprovalDialog
  actionName="Deploy Production Container"
  description="This will roll out revision v2.4.0 to all production nodes."
  dangerLevel="high"
  onApprove={() => console.log("Approved")}
  onReject={() => console.log("Rejected")}
/>
```

---

## 3. Composed Application Blocks

### AuthCard
```tsx
import { AuthCard } from "@kunemi-ui/blocks";

<AuthCard
  title="Sign in to Kunemi"
  description="Enter your email below to access your account"
  onSubmit={(email, password) => console.log({ email, password })}
/>
```

### MetricCard
```tsx
import { MetricCard } from "@kunemi-ui/blocks";

<MetricCard
  title="Active Tokens"
  value="1,420,850"
  delta="+18.4%"
  deltaType="positive"
  subtitle="vs previous billing cycle"
/>
```

### AIChatBlock
```tsx
import { AIChatBlock } from "@kunemi-ui/blocks";

<AIChatBlock
  messages={[
    { id: "1", role: "user", content: "Can you analyze our tokens?" },
    { id: "2", role: "assistant", content: "All tokens conform to WCAG 2.2 AA." }
  ]}
  toolInvocations={[
    { id: "t1", toolName: "TokenAnalyzer", status: "succeeded" }
  ]}
  onSendMessage={(prompt) => console.log("User sent:", prompt)}
/>
```

---

## 4. Experimental Behaviors (`@kunemi-ui/behaviors`)

Package: `@kunemi-ui/behaviors` (isolated from `@kunemi-ui/ui`).

- `useSelectionModel`: Multi-item selection manager with shift-click range select, cmd/ctrl toggle, select-all, and ARIA bindings.
- `useStreamResponse`: AI stream consumer state machine with buffered chunks, polite throttled live-region updates, sentence boundary flushes, error handling, and cancellation.
- `useTreeNavigation`: Hierarchical tree navigation with W3C APG arrow navigation, expand/collapse, and ARIA treeitem properties.
